name: SearchNews
title: Search News
description: Find recent news articles on a topic via SearchAPI.io (Google News)
whenToUse: Pick to find recent, DATED news articles on a topic: each result carries a publication date and source (Google News). Use it specifically when recency and an article's date matter; it returns dated news, not arbitrary web pages, videos, places, or social posts.

outputs.name: newsResults
outputs.description: News article results (title, url, source, date, snippet, thumbnail)

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Topic or keywords to search news for

numResults.title: Number of Results
numResults.description: Number of news results to return

country.title: Country
country.description: Country code for localized results, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'ae'

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: search
package.packageFile:
# FULLY DECLARATIVE. Four nodes, one endpoint, one key.
#
# SearchAPI.io is the cleanest case for this format: every engine is the SAME url switched
# by `engine=`, authenticated by one `api_key` in the query. `shared/searchapi.yaml` holds
# the call, each node names its engine and shapes its own reply, and the whole client is
# gone: `auth: apiKeyQuery` was already an executor capability.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/search/`.

name: search
displayName: Search
description: Web, news, video and places search via SearchAPI.io
version: 2.0.0
category: search
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3128/3128287.png

features:
  - Google web and image results
  - Google News, dated articles
  - YouTube video search
  - Google Maps places with ratings

allowedHosts:
  - www.searchapi.io

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyQuery]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.0.0"

credentials.searchapiCredential.yaml:
# One key powers every engine in this package. Transcribed from src/credentials/index.ts.

name: searchapiCredential
displayName: SearchAPI
description: SearchAPI.io credentials. One key powers every search engine in this package.
documentationUrl: https://www.searchapi.io/docs

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your SearchAPI.io API key
    placeholder: ""

shared.searchapi.yaml:
# The ONE call every node in this package makes.
#
# Same url, same auth, switched by `engine`. A node $refs this and layers its own `query`
# keys on top, which is what a $ref with siblings does: imported first, local wins.
#
# The key travels as a query parameter because that is what the vendor takes. `apiKeyQuery`
# is an executor capability, so no node handles a secret itself.

call: &call
  method: GET
  url: https://www.searchapi.io/api/v1/search
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyQuery
    param: api_key
    value: "{{ credentials.searchapiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Accept: application/json
  transport: json
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

# A 200 is not always a success here: the vendor reports a bad parameter or an exhausted
# quota in the body. Without this a failed search emits empty results and reads as "nothing
# found", which is the wrong answer rather than an error.
error: &error
  when: "return !!response.error"
  message: "return typeof response.error === 'string' ? response.error : JSON.stringify(response.error)"

files.api/events.yaml:
- emit: newsResults
  from: response
  # `source` arrives as a string on some results and as { name, icon } on others.
  #
  # A `data:` THUMBNAIL IS DROPPED, and this is a second line of defence rather than the fix. The fix
  # is the engine (see api/run.yaml): `google_news_light` returns thumbnail URLs where `google_news`
  # inlined ~3.5 KB of base64 per result. This rule means that if the engine is ever changed back, or
  # SearchApi starts inlining on the light engine too, the base64 still cannot reach the workflow
  # payload, the client or the event log.
  #
  # DROPPED RATHER THAN TRUNCATED, deliberately. A cut-off data URI is a CORRUPT image that a renderer
  # will still try to display and show as a broken tile, which is worse than no image: the field is
  # already declared as possibly-empty, so absence is a state every consumer handles.
  #
  # `slice` keeps `numResults` meaning what it says. The light engine honours `num` today — verified
  # against the live API, 10 requested and 10 returned — but that parameter is absent from its docs,
  # so this is what stops an undocumented change turning into a silently different result count.
  value: >-
    return (response.organic_results || []).slice(0, config.numResults || 10).map(r => ({
      title: r.title || "",
      url: r.link || "",
      source: typeof r.source === "string" ? r.source : (r.source || {}).name || "",
      date: r.date || "",
      snippet: r.snippet || "",
      thumbnail: (r.thumbnail || "").startsWith("data:") ? "" : r.thumbnail || ""
    }))
files.api/run.yaml:
# One call. The engine is what makes this node different from its three siblings.
#
# `google_news_light`, NOT `google_news`, and the difference is 31x on the wire.
#
# `google_news` returns each article's thumbnail as an inline `data:image/jpeg;base64,...` URI. There
# is no parameter that turns that off — SearchApi's `include_base_images` toggle belongs to the
# Shopping engine, not this one — so the base64 travelled into the workflow payload, over the
# WebSocket to the client, and through the XState event log, ~3.5 KB per result. The retired
# TypeScript node did exactly the same thing (`thumbnail: r.thumbnail || ""`), so this was never a
# migration regression; it was always wrong.
#
# The light engine returns a `https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/...` URL instead. MEASURED against
# the live API on 2026-07-27, same query and gl/hl, num=10:
#
#                      results   base64 thumbs   thumbnail bytes
#   google_news             10          10 / 10            35,538
#   google_news_light       10           0 / 10             1,160
#
# Response fields are IDENTICAL (position, title, link, source, date, snippet, thumbnail) and `source`
# is a plain string on both, so the events table needed no change at all.
#
# `num` IS honoured even though the light engine's docs omit it — verified above, 10 requested and 10
# returned. Kept for that reason, and because dropping it would silently change every saved
# workflow's result count. If SearchApi ever stops honouring it, the events table's `slice` is what
# keeps `numResults` meaning what it says.

- $ref: searchapi#call
  name: search
  error: { $ref: searchapi#error }
  query:
    engine: google_news_light
    q: "{{ config.query }}"
    num: "{{ config.numResults }}"
    gl: "{{ config.country }}"
    hl: "{{ config.language }}"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [query]
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      title: Search Query
      description: Topic or keywords to search news for
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    numResults:
      type: number
      title: Number of Results
      description: Number of news results to return
      default: 20
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
    country:
      type: string
      title: Country
      description: Country code for localized results, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'ae'
      default: us
    language:
      type: string
      title: Language
      description: Language code for results, e.g. 'en', 'ar'
      default: en
"ui:order": [query, numResults, country, language]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: query
    type: string
    description: Search query
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: newsResults
    type: array
    description: News article results (title, url, source, date, snippet, thumbnail)

credentials:
  - name: searchapiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: SearchAPI
files.node.yaml:
type: SearchNews
kind: PromiseNode
name: Search News
category: Search
color: "#DB4437"
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/2965/2965879.png
description: Find recent news articles on a topic via SearchAPI.io (Google News)
whenToUse: >
  Pick to find recent, DATED news articles on a topic: each result carries a publication
  date and source (Google News). Use it specifically when recency and an article's date
  matter; it returns dated news, not arbitrary web pages, videos, places, or social posts.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  cacheable: true
files.test.yaml:
testData:
  config:
    query: AI regulation
    numResults: 10
    country: us
    language: en
  inputs:
    query: AI regulation
  expect:
    newsResults: "return output.newsResults.length > 0 && typeof output.newsResults[0].title === 'string'"
